synopsis: ASAM’s 2025 high-fidelity OSI project is extending sensor interfaces [f7169]. Its scheduled duration is April 2025 to March 2027 [f8326]. The tools chapter lists it among the main simulation credibility references, while characterizing those references as on-road and pre-standard; this limits the stated basis for treating it as an established heavy off-road validation framework [f8323].

relations.note: Gives the April 2025–March 2027 schedule for the sensor-interface extension project.
